title: 3307. Find the K-th Character in String Game II

examples.explanation: Initially, word == "a". Alice performs the three operations as follows: Appends "a" to "a", word becomes "aa". Appends "aa" to "aa", word becomes "aaaa". Appends "aaaa" to "aaaa", word becomes "aaaaaaaa".

Initially, word == "a". Alice performs the four operations as follows: Appends "a" to "a", word becomes "aa". Appends "bb" to "aa", word becomes "aabb". Appends "aabb" to "aabb", word becomes "aabbaabb". Appends "bbccbbcc" to "aabbaabb", word becomes "aabbaabbbbccbbcc".
